description: This file contains functions for upgrading eMMC storage in an OpenWrt system, including tar-based and FIT-based upgrades, as well as configuration copying and general upgrade orchestration.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Handles eMMC upgrade using a tar archive, extracts kernel, root filesystem, and device tree blob, and writes them to specified devices.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Handles eMMC upgrade using a FIT image, writes the image to the kernel partition.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies upgrade backup data to eMMC data, root, or kernel partitions.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the file type and invokes the appropriate upgrade function.
